g.text: Public employment as a share of the workforce
Direct measure | The denominator is the workforce represented in Stats NZ Business Demography, not HLFS total employment. The
download stops in 2023 despite being linked from a 2025 page.
Sources: PSC/Stats NZ workforce headcount by sector and region, 2000-2023 (download linked from 2025 page)
